items.text: The tab a dragged pane rests on now lights up while it waits to open.
Activity Monitor cells now show their full text on hover.
A click beside a folded viewer never brings it out, and a test now proves it.
The commit guard accepts a wildcard pathspec instead of calling its own files another session's work.
A sign-in or sharing result now updates every open machine chooser, not just the first.
A pane popped out of a maximized window now opens at the window's restored size.
